label: talos
command: cmake -DENABLE_CALIBRATION=OFF -G Ninja -B build -S . && cmake --build build --target talos -j64 && ./build/bin/talos

label: calibration
command: cmake -DENABLE_CALIBRATION=ON -G Ninja -B build -S . && cmake --build build --target rm_calibration -j64 && ./build/bin/rm_calibration
